Mean values of significant E-P interactions per trait.
```{r}
trait_mean_enh_range <- loci_enh_op %>%
  filter(!is.na(enh)) %>%
  #signf long range
  # filter(emp < 0.001) %>%
  select(SNPS, enh, emp, MAPPED_TRAIT, enh_trans_range, symbol, ensembl, GWAS_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(enh_trans_range),
            count = dplyr::n(),
            genes_symbol = paste0(unique(symbol), collapse = ", "),
            genes_ensembl = paste0(unique(ensembl), collapse = ", "),
            GWAS_sum = paste0(unique(GWAS_GENES), collapse = ", "),
            jaccard = ProportionOfGenesShared(symbol, str_split(GWAS_sum, pattern = ", ",simplify = TRUE)[1,])) %>%
  as.data.frame()

```

# Enh-P interaction range background
## Loading
```{r}
chr_vec <- paste0("chr", c(1:22)) %>%
  append("chrX")
grbs <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "GRBs_CNE_density_modf_kurtosis.rds"))
transcripts <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir,  "TSSs.perTranscript.gr.rds"))

# Is transcript in GRB 
transcripts$TinGRB <- FALSE
transcripts[(transcripts %in% subsetByOverlaps(transcripts, grbs))]$TinGRB <- TRUE

trans_range <- data.frame(gene = str_c(transcripts$ensembl_gene_id, transcripts$ensembl_transcript_id, sep = ":"),
                          transcript_position = start(transcripts),
                          TinGRB = transcripts$TinGRB)
rm(transcripts)
```


## Per chromosome
Each empP_gr file is separated by chromosome. Adding distance between *start of enhancer* and *start of transcript* in metacolumn of gr object. Adding flags if enhancer is in GRB. Saving each chromosome into a new version with distances and flags.
```{r}
for(chr in chr_vec[4:23]){
  
  # empP_gr <- load_per_chr_empP_file(chr, emp_dir = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "empP_files"))
  empP_gr <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "empP_files_denovo", paste0("empP_CAGEen_denovo_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_", chr, ".rds")))
  # mcols(empP_gr) <- left_join(as.data.frame(mcols(empP_gr)), trans_range, by="gene") 
  empP_gr$EP_dist <- abs(abs((end(empP_gr) + start(empP_gr))/2  - empP_gr$transcript_position))
  # empP_gr[empP_gr$empP == 0]$empP <- 1
  
  empP_gr$EinGRB <- FALSE
  empP_gr[(empP_gr %in% subsetByOverlaps(empP_gr, grbs))]$EinGRB <- TRUE
  saveRDS(empP_gr, file = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_files_denovo", paste0(chr, "empP_CAGEenhPermissive_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_with_distances")))
}
```



Plotting distances across chromosome. Trying out different combinations.
## Eout - Pany vs Ein - Pany
```{r}
dir_name <- "Eout-Pany_vs_Ein-Pany_denovo"

for(chr in chr_vec[c(1:7, 9:11,13:15, 17,18, 20:23)]){
  
  # empP_gr <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_files_denovo", paste0(chr, "_empP_CAGEenhPermissive_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_with_distances")))

  
  
  data_ <- mcols(empP_gr) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::filter(empP*length(empP_gr) < 0.001) 

  options(scipen = 999)
  ggplot(data_, aes(x = as.numeric(transcript_position), y = EP_dist, color = EinGRB)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values =c("gray30", "darkred"), )
ggsave(width = 21, height = 7, filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", dir_name, paste0(chr, "_EP_distance_across_chromosome_corrected.png")))

ggplot(data_, aes(x=EinGRB, y=EP_dist, fill = EinGRB)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray30", "darkred")) +
  theme_bw()+ 
  scale_y_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = give.n, geom = "text")+
  stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", color = "yellow", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test")
ggsave(filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", dir_name,  paste0(chr, "_EP_distance_boxplot.png")), bg = "white")

  
  data_ <- ranges(filter(empP_gr, empP < 0.001) ) %>% table()  %>% as.data.frame()
  ggplot(data = data_, aes(x = Freq)) +
    geom_histogram(bins=50, color = "black", fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.4) + 
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle("Number of signif(<0.001) interactions per E")
  ggsave(filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", dir_name, paste0(chr, "_EP_freq_per_enh_distribution.png")))
}
```

```{r}
genome_ep_dists <- genome_EP_distance %>%
  filter(inGRB == FALSE) %>%
  pull(EP_dist)
enh_dist_p <- c()

median(genome_ep_dists)
for(trait in unique(trait_mean_enh_range$MAPPED_TRAIT)){
  pheno_ep_dists <- loci_enh_op %>%
    filter(MAPPED_TRAIT == trait ) %>%
    filter(emp < 0.001) %>%
    pull(enh_trans_range)
  if(length(pheno_ep_dists) < 5){
    enh_dist_p <- c(enh_dist_p, "not enough observations")
    next}
  enh_dist_p <- c(enh_dist_p, t.test(pheno_ep_dists, genome_ep_dists, alternative = "greater")$p.value)
  
}

trait_mean_enh_range$enh_dist_p <- enh_dist_p
```

# Detecting V-enhancers
## Loading data
Loading data
```{r}
file_ <- file.path(project_dir, paste0("data/random/", "TableS13.bed.u_enhancers_tissue_based.txt"))

u_enhancers <- read.table(file = file_, row.names = NULL)
colnames(u_enhancers) <- c("V1","V2","V3")

u_enhancers.gr <- GRanges(seqnames =u_enhancers$V1,
                           ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(u_enhancers$V2) +1 ,
                                            end = as.numeric(u_enhancers$V3) +1))
```


```{r}
x <- table(genome_EP_distance$gene)

probs <- 0.8
cutoff <- quantile(x, probs = probs)


ggplot(data = data.frame(x), aes(x = (x))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),  fill="gray", color="black", bins = 50) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, fill="violet", color="black") +
  labs(title="Number of transcripts associated", x="x", y="Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype="dashed", color = "purple", size=0.9) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = cutoff, y = 0.025, color = 'purple', label = paste0("Cutoff: ", probs*100, "% =" ,cutoff), hjust = -0.1)
```

```{r}
x <- table(genome_EP_distance$start)
genome_EP_distance <- genome_EP_distance %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(vEnh = ifelse(n() >= cutoff, TRUE,FALSE)) %>%
  ungroup()

genome_EP_distance$vEnh %>% table()
select(genome_EP_distance,seqnames, start, end, vEnh) %>%
  unique() %>%
  pull(vEnh) %>%
  table()

v_enhancers <- select(genome_EP_distance,seqnames, start, end, vEnh) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(vEnh)
```


```{r}
genome_EP_distance.gr <- GRanges(genome_EP_distance)
v_enhancers.gr <- GRanges(v_enhancers)

subsetByOverlaps(unique(genome_EP_distance.gr), u_enhancers.gr)$vEnh %>% table

subsetByOverlaps(v_enhancers.gr, u_enhancers.gr)
subsetByOverlaps(u_enhancers.gr, v_enhancers.gr)

subsetByOverlaps(u_enhancers.gr, genome_EP_distance.gr)
```

## Adding vEnh info into emp_gr
- for some reason, it doesn't join
```{r, message=FALSE}
for(chr in chr_vec){
  
  empP_gr <- load_per_chr_empP_file(chr, emp_dir = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "empP_files"))
  mcols(empP_gr) <- dplyr::left_join(as.data.frame(mcols(empP_gr)), trans_range, by="gene") 
  empP_gr$EP_dist <- abs(start(empP_gr) - empP_gr$transcript_position)

  empP_gr$EinGRB <- FALSE
  empP_gr[(empP_gr %in% subsetByOverlaps(empP_gr, grbs))]$EinGRB <- TRUE
  
  empP_gr$uEnh <- FALSE
  empP_gr[(empP_gr %in% subsetByOverlaps(empP_gr, u_enhancers.gr))]$uEnh <- TRUE
  
  empP_gr$vEnh <- FALSE
  empP_gr[(empP_gr %in% subsetByOverlaps(empP_gr, v_enhancers.gr))]$vEnh <- TRUE
  
  saveRDS(empP_gr, file = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", paste0(chr, "empP_CAGEenhPermissive_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_with_distances_and_uEnh")))
}
```

Beannplot individual modified, that saves files
```{r}
plot_beanplot_individual_modified <- function(expression_for_pair, neuronal, col2plot, sign="mwu", n, fn = "beanplot.png") {
  
  par(mar=c(2,1,2,1))
  
  # significance can be determined by Mann-Whitney-U test, 
  # or permutation of the median based (needs raw, pre-log TPMs) 
  if(sign=="mwu") {
    # two-sided unpaired two sample wilcox test is MW-U test
    p <- wilcox.test(expression_for_pair$prom[expression_for_pair$enh_expression==0], 
                     expression_for_pair$prom[expression_for_pair$enh_expression> 0])$p.value
  }
  else if(sign=="permutation") {
    #determining significance string to plot (permutation-based deviation of the mean)
    p <- empP_diff_in_median_sampling(expression_for_pair, iter=10000)
    print(p)
  }
  else {
    p <- NA
  }
  # multiple testing correction, Bonferonni
  p <- n*p
  
  # ** in p <=0.01, *** if p<=0.001, nothing otherwise
  s <- ifelse(p<=0.001, "***", ifelse(p<=0.01, "**", ifelse(p<=0.05, "*", "")))
  #print(paste("P after correction", p))
  print(paste("Dimension of expression pair", dim(expression_for_pair)))
  
  expression_for_pair$enh_expression <- log_transform(expression_for_pair$enh_expression, 10)
  expression_for_pair$prom <- log_transform(expression_for_pair$prom, 10)

png(filename = fn, 
    width = 500,
    height = 500) 
  beanplot(expression_for_pair$prom[expression_for_pair$enh_expression==0], 
           expression_for_pair$prom[expression_for_pair$enh_expression> 0],
           # default bw reports 'Error in bw.SJ(x, method = "dpi") : sample is too sparse to find TD'
           show.names=F, bw="nrd0", 
           #wd=bp$wd*(vec/max(vec)),
           log="", side="both",
           overallline = "median",
           beanlines="median",
           col= list(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[8], c(col2plot, "white")),
           what=c(0,1,1,0), border=NA, ylim=c(0,3)) 
  
  legend(x=0.75, y=3.55, legend=s, bty="n", cex=6, text.col="black")
dev.off()
}
```

## De novo plots

### One chromosome
```{r}
empP_chr2 <- read.table(file.path(project_dir, "data/processed/empP_files_denovo/chr2_empP_CAGEen_denovo_hg19Ens_6.4Mb.txt"), header = TRUE) %>%
  select(-chr, -enh.1)

empP_chr2 <- left_join(as.data.frame(empP_chr2), 
                       trans_range)
empP_gr <- grangesFromDataframe(empP_chr2, enh) 
empP_gr$EP_dist <- abs(abs((end(empP_gr) + start(empP_gr))/2  - empP_gr$transcript_position))

data_ <- mcols(empP_gr) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  # filter(empP < 0.001 & empP != 0)
  filter(empP < 0.001)

ggplot(data_, aes(x = as.numeric(transcript_position), y = EP_dist, color = TinGRB)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values =c("gray30", "darkred"), )

ggplot(data_, aes(x=TinGRB, y=EP_dist, fill = TinGRB)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray30", "darkred")) +
  theme_bw()+ 
  scale_y_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = give.n, geom = "text")+
  stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", color = "yellow", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test")
```

Trying out alternative score
```{r}
dir_name <- "Eany-Pin_vs_Eany-Pout_denovo-byScore"

for(chr in chr_vec){


  empP_gr <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir,"empP_files_denovo", paste0(chr, "_empP_CAGEen_denovo_hg19Ens_6.4Mb_gr.rds")))

  data_ <- mcols(empP_gr) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    # filter(empP < 0.001 & empP != 0)
    filter(empP < 0.05) %>% 
    mutate(log10_empP = ifelse(empP == 0, -log10(0.00001), -log10(empP))) %>%
    mutate(score = log10_empP * log10(EP_dist))


  ggplot(data_, aes(x = as.numeric(transcript_position), y = score, color = TinGRB)) +
  # ggplot(data_, aes(x = (EP_dist), y = score, color = TinGRB)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    # scale_y_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
    theme_bw() + 
    scale_color_manual(values =c("gray30", "darkred"), )
    ggsave( width = 21, height = 7 ,filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", dir_name, paste0(chr, "_EP_distance_across_chromosome.png")))

  ggplot(data_, aes(x=TinGRB, y=score, fill = TinGRB)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray30", "darkred")) +
    theme_bw()+ 
    scale_y_continuous(labels=fancy_scientific) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = give.n, geom = "text")+
    stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", color = "yellow", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE)+
    stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test")
    ggsave(filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "empP_EP_distance", dir_name,  paste0(chr, "_EP_distance_boxplot.png")), bg = "white")

  }
```
